task_description: Build the 4 remaining Propela Ops modules: Module 4 (Cohort Manager), Module 3 (Nurse Acquisition Hub), Module 1 (Dashboard), and Module 5 (Template Library). Each module includes new routes, components, types, mock data, Zustand stores, and sidebar navigation updates following existing patterns.
